# ==========================================
# 1. KONFIGURACJA SILVER -> GOLD
# ==========================================

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

account = "stjobmarketdev01"
silver_base = f"abfss://silver@{account}.dfs.core.windows.net/jobs/source=solidjobs/"
gold_base = f"abfss://gold@{account}.dfs.core.windows.net/jobs/fact_job_snapshots/"

Path = spark._jvm.org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path
hadoop_conf = spark._jsc.hadoopConfiguration()
silver_fs = Path(silver_base).getFileSystem(hadoop_conf)
gold_fs = Path(gold_base).getFileSystem(hadoop_conf)

print("SILVER:", silver_base)
print("GOLD:", gold_base)

# ==========================================
# 3. WALIDACJA I ZAPIS FACT_JOB_SNAPSHOTS
# ==========================================

written_dates = []
skipped_dates = []

for snapshot_date, snapshot_path in selected_snapshots:
    output_path = gold_base + f"snapshot_date={snapshot_date}/"
    output_dir = Path(output_path)
    success_path = Path(output_path + "_SUCCESS")

    # Idempotencja: kompletny dzień pomijamy bez odczytywania Parquet.
    if gold_fs.exists(success_path):
        print(f"{snapshot_date}: Gold istnieje (_SUCCESS) — pomijam.")
        skipped_dates.append(snapshot_date)
        continue

    # Nie nadpisujemy nawet częściowo utworzonego katalogu.
    if gold_fs.exists(output_dir):
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{snapshot_date}: katalog Gold istnieje, ale brak _SUCCESS. "
            "Wymagana ręczna diagnostyka — niczego nie nadpisuję."
        )

    # Jeden zweryfikowany snapshot Silver na dzień.
    daily_jobs = spark.read.parquet(snapshot_path)
    gold_jobs = daily_jobs.select(
        F.lit(snapshot_date).alias("snapshot_date"),
        F.col("jobOfferKey").alias("job_id"),
        F.col("title"),
        F.col("company"),
        F.col("category"),
        F.col("experienceLevel"),
        F.col("isRemote"),
        F.col("isHybrid"),
        F.col("salary.from").alias("salary_from"),
        F.col("salary.to").alias("salary_to"),
        F.col("salary.currency").alias("salary_currency"),
        F.col("salary.period").alias("salary_period"),
        F.col("run_id"),
    )

    # Walidujemy PRZED deduplikacją i PRZED zapisem.
    invalid_ids = gold_jobs.filter(
        F.col("job_id").isNull()
        | (F.trim(F.col("job_id").cast("string")) == "")
    ).limit(1).count()
    duplicate_ids = (
        gold_jobs.groupBy("job_id")
        .count()
        .filter(F.col("count") > 1)
        .limit(1)
        .count()
    )
    row_count = gold_jobs.count()

    if row_count == 0 or invalid_ids or duplicate_ids:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{snapshot_date}: DATA QUALITY FAILED "
            f"(rows={row_count}, invalid_ids={invalid_ids}, "
            f"duplicate_ids={duplicate_ids}). Gold nie został zapisany."
        )

    # snapshot_date jest w nazwie partycji; Spark odtworzy ją przy
    # czytaniu tabeli Gold z katalogu głównego.
    (
        gold_jobs.drop("snapshot_date")
        .write
        .mode("errorifexists")
        .parquet(output_path)
    )
    written_dates.append(snapshot_date)
    print(f"{snapshot_date}: DATA QUALITY PASSED; zapisano {row_count} rekordów.")

# ==========================================
# 4. PODSUMOWANIE PRZETWARZANIA GOLD
# ==========================================

print("====================================")
print("GOLD — FACT_JOB_SNAPSHOTS")
print("Zapisane dni:", written_dates)
print("Pominięte dni:", skipped_dates)
print("Katalog Gold:", gold_base)
print("PRZETWARZANIE ZAKOŃCZONE")
